inspected.isometric.png: Inspected against Liberty17 arrangement: shaft and bearings sit in the lower case; closures now replace open journal ends. Source rods, studs, upper engine and gear remain absent. No fitted camera/profile claim.
inspected.shaft.png: Inspected against Liberty17/107 for six-throw layout and end locations. Caps and retaining hardware are individually visible; hidden cap profiles are not established by those source images.
inspected.pin6_section.png: Deep nose-side recess and shallow gear-side cap are visible; both gaskets and central source-length stud fit. Rear-web drilling opens inboard of the cap. Asymmetric recess is an inferred routing solution.
inspected.main2_section.png: Paired main caps and gaskets enclose the hollow journal, with clearance around the axial stud. Nut/washer stack is seated; shapes remain estimates.
inspected.gear_section.png: Ordinary inboard cap and larger gear-end cap fit their seats. Caption now correctly calls the stud length derived. Driving gear is absent.
inspected.nose_section.png: Corrected Z half-section exposes nose plug inboard of cotter and material behind the key-screw receiver. Old Y half-section hid that receiver. Reduced bore/transition are estimates.
inspected.oil_web_section.png: Rear-web passage connects main and pin cavities in the retained half-section; the external drill access is visibly plugged and the rear cap does not cross the passage.

source_comparison: Direct inspection of native renders and original Liberty17/107; catalogue profiles and counts compared with retained SNL scans/dossier, including direct SNL239 scan inspection this turn.
limitations: LQ272A quantity and LQ166A size conflicts remain unresolved.
